## Statement

Self-interaction potential of the χ-field — spontaneous symmetry breaking form.

## Formal Expression

```
V(χ) = λ(χ² - v²)² — Mexican hat potential
```

V(χ) = λ(χ² - v²)² — Mexican hat potential

Definition: V(χ) = quartic self-interaction potential.
